purpose: Measure healthy useful-work coverage, SAME MAIN fast continuation, and SAME MAIN cold-fallback recovery separately. Watchdog is disabled standby and not part of normal SLO.

normal_rolling_continuation_gap.definition: first meaningful next-invocation progress minus predecessor normal-close reference after verified close+offset rearm
normal_rolling_continuation_gap.note: Do not equate configured +60s DTSTART offset with actual delivery latency; measure each wake.

abrupt_loss_recovery_gap.definition: first meaningful replacement-worker progress minus last meaningful predecessor progress after unexpected disappearance

main_cold_fallback_recovery_gap.definition: first durable useful progress on a natural SAME MAIN recurring occurrence minus the failed shifted wake due or last predecessor progress, preserving unknown boundaries

actions_schedule_limit: GitHub officially documents a minimum 5-minute schedule interval and warns scheduled workflows can be delayed under load and may even be dropped. Therefore Actions cron is a liveness rescue layer, not a <=120-second fast-recovery mechanism.

promotion_rule: Do not call RRuleR SaaS-grade on nominal scheduling alone. Require accepted useful-work windows plus observed SAME MAIN fast-path bootstrap reliability and honest cold-fallback recovery evidence without duplicate substantive execution.
